purpose: Frozen eval run 2 on the 0.1.4 skill. The files hashed here and the decision rule below are fixed BEFORE the run; nothing may change until the results are recorded; results are reported as they are.
skill_version: 0.1.4 (uncommitted SKILL.md hashed below is committed in the freeze commit)

decision_rule.default_model: 15 cases x 3 runs. A case passes when at least 2 of its 3 runs pass every check. Bar: at least 14 of 15 cases pass.
decision_rule.smaller_model_haiku: 15 cases x 3 runs, same case rule. Bar: at least 12 of 15 cases pass.
decision_rule.triggers: 20 queries x 3 runs, default model. Bar: at least 24 of 30 should-fire runs fire the skill and 0 of 30 must-not-fire runs do.
decision_rule.invariants: No run edits a sent tailoring file; no run writes an invented number into a saved or built file.

results.recorded: as run; the five frozen files were verified unchanged by hash after the run

invariants.data_folder_changed_when_it_must_not: none in the 36 runs where the unchanged-data check applies (6 cases x 3 repeats x 2 models); the other case runs carry no such check
invariants.edit_or_write_of_a_tailoring_file_in_the: none to the sent file. One smaller-model run (e08, repeat 2) wrote a NEW copy, out/acme-backend-tc/tailoring.json, in the derived out/ folder; the sent tailoring was untouched

check_defect_found_after_the_run.what: the regex ends in \b after 'was:', which cannot match 'was: "..."' (a colon followed by a space is not a word boundary). All 3 default-model e05 outputs show the new was:/now: layout, so the behaviour was right in 3 of 3; the frozen rule counted 1 of 3.
check_defect_found_after_the_run.regrade_of_the_same_3_outputs_with_the_r: 3 of 3 (the other checks of e05 had passed in those runs); the corrected regex was committed in the same commit as this record, after the last run had finished, and was not used for the numbers above
